bundled.built_from: PHP 8.5.12 compiled from the official php.net source for Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 with the CLI and Grocy required extensions. The installed opt/php/bin/php, Ubuntu shared libraries missing from the base image, and their license notices were gathered under opt/php and archived. The program and libraries are unmodified; PHP input and build flags are recorded in notes.

modifications: Upstream release and PHP runtime are unmodified. Local launch/seed/router scripts configure the data directory, offline barcode lookup and PHP web serving.
configuration: SQLite under DATA_DIR; initial admin/admin account; English locale and UTC; the upstream DemoBarcodeLookupPlugin replaces the network barcode lookup; printer features remain disabled. The runtime supplies the advancing application/browser clock with its documented fixed start.
